title: kovidgoyal/calibre
content: calibre 是一个电子书管理器。它可以查看、转换、编辑和编目所有主要电子书格式的电子书。它还可以与电子书阅读器设备通信。它可以访问互联网并获取书籍的元数据。它可以下载报纸并将其转换为电子书，以便于阅读。它是跨平台的，可在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上运行。 更多信息，请参见 [calibre 关于页面](https://calibre-ebook.com/about)。 ## 截图 [截图页面](https://calibre-ebook.com/demo) ## 用法 请参见 [用户手册](https://manual.calibre-ebook.com)。 ## 开发 [为 calibre 设置开发环境](https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/develop.html)。 当前 calibre 版本的[源代码 tarball](https://calibre-ebook.com/dist/src)。 ## Bug Bug 报告和功能请求应在 [Launchpad](https://bugs.launchpad.net/calibre) 上的 calibre bug 跟踪器中提出。 GitHub 仅用于代码托管和 pull request。 ## 支持 calibre calibre 是来自世界各地的许多志愿者共同努力的结果。如果您觉得它有用，请考虑捐款以支持其开发。 [捐赠以支持 calibre 开发](https://calibre-ebook.com/donate)。 ## 构建 calibre 二进制文件 有关如何为 calibre 支持的所有平台构建 calibre 二进制文件和安装程序的说明，请参见 [构建说明](bypy/README.rst)。

metadata.description: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
metadata.rawMarkdown: # calibre calibre is an e-book manager. It can view, convert, edit and catalog e-books in all of the major e-book formats. It can also talk to e-book reader devices. It can go out to the internet and fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS. For more information, see the [calibre About page](https://calibre-ebook.com/about). [![Build Status](https://github.com/kovidgoyal/calibre/workflows/CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kovidgoyal/calibre/actions?query=workflow%3ACI) ## Screenshots [Screenshots page](https://calibre-ebook.com/demo) ## Usage See the [User Manual](https://manual.calibre-ebook.com). ## Development [Setting up a development environment for calibre](https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/develop.html). A [tarball of the source code](https://calibre-ebook.com/dist/src) for the current calibre release. ## Bugs Bug reports and feature requests should be made in the calibre bug tracker at [Launchpad](https://bugs.launchpad.net/calibre). GitHub is only used for code hosting and pull requests. ## Support calibre calibre is a result of the efforts of many volunteers from all over the world. If you find it useful, please consider contributing to support its development. [Donate to support calibre development](https://calibre-ebook.com/donate). ## Building calibre binaries See [Build instructions](bypy/README.rst) for instructions on how to build the calibre binaries and installers for all the platforms calibre supports. ## calibre package versions in various repositories [![Packaging Status](https://repology.org/badge/vertical-allrepos/calibre.svg?columns=3&header=calibre)](https://repology.org/project/calibre/versions)
